Kinontra ni Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla ang pahayag ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano na "under attack" ang Senado noong Mayo 13, 2026.

text:
‘HE WAS NOT ARMED’

Kinumpirma ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Sec. Jonvic Remulla na hindi armado ang ang inarestong driver-volunteer ng National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).

Ayon kay Remulla sa isang press briefing, inutusan lamang ito na kunin ang tactical bag na naiwan ng isang agent na nagbabantay sa pinto.

Nauna nang itinanggi ng inarestong driver na namaril siya nang mangyari ang gulo sa Senado noong May 13.

text:
SINI-SINGLE OUT SI REP. DUTERTE?

Itinanggi ni ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio ang akusasyon ni 1st District Davao City Rep. Pulong Duterte na "selective" siya sa pagpapanagot kaugnay sa flood control scandal.

Kasunod ito ng paghahain ni Tinio ng reklamo sa Ombudsman para paimbestigahan ang umano'y irregular flood contro projects sa distrito ni Rep. Duterte.

"Hindi po selective ang ating paniningil sa corruption," ayon kay Tinio sa programang #SaTotooLang.

text:
LOOK: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. welcomed United States Under Secretary of State for Economic Growth, Energy, and the Environment Jacob Helberg at Malacañang today, May 19.

Their discussions focused on the Luzon Economic Corridor (LEC), Pax Silica initiatives, investment and technology partnerships, supply chain cooperation, and other key trade priorities affecting both countries.

The LEC, in particular, is envisioned to generate up to 1 million jobs for Filipinos and help drive double-digit economic growth for the country. | 📸: PCO via Dexter Cabalza, Philippine Daily Inquirer

media.ocrText: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) has appealed to potential voter registrants to sign up ahead of the deadline because the poll body may next open its voters’ registration in February 2027, or before the  2028 national and local elections.

text:
REGISTER TO VOTE! 🗳️

The Commission on Elections (Comelec) has appealed to potential voter registrants to sign up ahead of the deadline because the poll body may next open its voters’ registration in February 2027, or before the 2028 national and local elections.

Check the full story in our comments.

media.ocrText: May be an image of ‎text that says '‎PHILIPPINE PHILIPPINESTAR STAR SENATE OF H PHILIPHINES DILG: THERE WAS NO I سحمم ATTACK ON THE SENATE LAST MAY 13, 2026‎'‎

text:
Nilinaw ni Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla na walang pag-atake na nangyari sa Senado noong Mayo 13, 2026, matapos nitong imbestigahan ang insidente ng pagpapaputok ng baril sa ikalawang palapag ng institusyon. 

Taliwas ito sa pahayag ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano at ilang miyembro ng mayorya na “under attack” ang Senado. 

Ibinahagi naman ni Philippine National Police Chief Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. ang pagkakasunod-sunod ng mga pangyayari simula noong umapela si Senator Bato dela Rosa sa mga tao hanggang sa pagtakas nito sa Senate protective custody.

text:
ILLEGAL PRESENCE NG CCG VESSEL MALAPIT SA ZAMBALES

Na-monitor ng Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang presensya ng China Coast Guard (CCG) vessel CCG-4305 sa loob ng exclusive economic zone ng Pilipinas, sa layong 48 nautical miles kanluran ng Pandaquit, Zambales, ngayong Martes, May 19.

Agad na nagpadala ang PCG ng aerial at surface assets para mag-issue ng radio challenge at itaboy ang Chinese vessel.

text:
Ayon kina Batangas 2nd district Rep. Gerville Luistro at ML Partylist Rep. Leila De Lima, dapat dumalo si Vice President Sara Duterte sa impeachment trial bilang parte umano ng kanyang accountability at due process sa mga isyung hinaharap niya. 
 
“Alalahanin po natin na this is also due process for VP Sara. So pagkakataon niya ‘to. This is time for her to face and answer the accusations against her. Kung walang kasalanan, dapat walang iniiwasan,” saad ni De Lima sa press briefing nitong Martes, May 19, 2026. 
 
“In addition to that being part of her due process, this is likewise her Constitutional duty. The people are waiting for her answers. Aligned to that accountability mandate, she should attend and present her defense,” dagdag ni Luistro.

Matutuloy umano ang impeachment trial laban kay Vice President Sara Duterte kahit hindi ito dumalo, ayon kay ouse lead prosecutor Rep. Gerville Luistro.

"Kahit hindi dumating ang Bise Presidente, kahit hindi siya mag-file ng answer, kahit hindi dumating ang defense lawyers nila, tutuloy pa rin ang trial,” saad ni Luistro sa press briefing nitong Martes.

text:
AUSTRALIAN LAWYER NAMED DUTERTE’S ASSOCIATE COUNSEL AT ICC

Australian lawyer Kate Gibson has been appointed as new associate counsel of former president Rodrigo Duterte at the International Criminal Court (ICC). 

Gibson, who has appeared in various international courts and tribunals, was tapped by Duterte’s lead defense counsel Peter Haynes to be part of the defense team, according to an ICC Registry filing released on Tuesday. 

She formally accepted the role on May 18, 2026.

Gibson worked with Haynes on the ICC case against Congolese politician Jean-Pierre Bemba, who was acquitted on appeal in 2018.

She was also appointed as associate counsel to represent the interests of Ugandan militant Joseph Kony during his confirmation hearings, which were held in absentia last year. 

A former president of the Association of Defence Counsel Practising Before the International Courts and Tribunals, Gibson also appeared before other international tribunals, including the Special Court for Sierra Leone, UN Residual Mechanism for Criminal Tribunals, UN International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, and the Kosovo Specialist Chambers. 

Gibson served as legal consultant to the International Fact-Finding Mission on Myanmar and currently represents some Rohingya victims, according to her profile on the website of the United Kingdom-based Doughty Street Chambers, where she is an associate. | via Janvic Mateo

text:
SWIMMING, ANO, TARA? 🏊🏻‍♀️☀️

Pumalo sa 46°C ang heat index o damang init sa San Ildefonso, Bulacan ngayong Martes, May 19, base sa tala ng DOST-PAGASA.

Dito naitala ang pinakamataas na heat index sa bansa ngayong araw na pasok sa “danger” level.

Sa ilalim ng level na ito, maaaring maranasan ang heat cramps at heat exhaustion sa ilalim nito. Maaaring humantong sa heat stroke ang patuloy na pagkababad sa init.

PREPARING FOR IMPEACHMENT TRIAL

The House prosecution panel has designated Rep. Gerville Luistro as the overall lead prosecutor, while also assigning specific lead prosecutors per Article of Impeachment against Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

media.ocrText: May be an image of text that says 'photo: House photo:Houseof photo:HousaofRapresentafives of Representafives Hindi po kami natatakot sa susunod na eleksyon dahil naniniwala po kami a makikita ng taumbayan ang ebidensya. REP. BEL ZAMORA Member, House prosecution panel May 19, 2026 Sa maaaring epekto ng kanilang gampanin VS impeachment ni VP Duterte sa susunod πα eleksyon NEWS 5'

text:
‘HINDI PO KAMI NABABAHALA’

Iginiit ni San Juan City Rep. Bel Zamora, miyembro ng 11-member House prosecution panel, na hindi sila nababahala na makaapekto sa kanila sa susunod na eleksyon ang magiging gampanin nila kaugnay sa impeachment laban kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

Ayon kay Zamora, tinutupad nila ang constitutional duty bilang House prosecutors at mga kinatawan ng kanilang nasasakupan.

“Lahat po kami ay nandito para lang ipakita ang ebidensya laban sa bise presidente, na nakita naming may pagkakasala. Kaya nga po naglabas po tayo ng articles of impeachment,” sabi niya.

“It is now incumbent upon the senators to fulfill their constitutional duties as well,” dagdag niya. I via Marianne Enriquez

text:
DILG: THERE WAS NO ATTACK ON THE SENATE

Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. officially turns over documentary evidence related to the May 13 Senate shooting event to Department of Justice (DOJ) Acting Secretary Frederick Vida after the press briefing at Malacañang on Tuesday. 

Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla clarified that their investigation revealed that "there was no attack on the Senate," calling the supposed shootout a "gun-related incident." 

Nartatez also disclosed that Senators Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa and Robin Padilla entered an SUV at around 2:30 a.m. on Thursday, May 14, 2026, before leaving the Senate premises. (Photos by Noel Pabalate/The Philippine STAR)

text:
NBI NOW AUTHORIZED TO OPEN FRANCO MABANTA'S GADGETS 

National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag announced Tuesday that the Pasig Regional Trial Court has approved a cyber warrant authorizing agents to access the digital devices of social media personality and Peanut Gallery Media Network (PGMN) founder Franco Mabanta and his associates.

The warrant allows investigators to extract data from the devices to aid their ongoing investigation.

Authorities allege that Mabanta’s group attempted to extort P300 million from former House speaker Martin Romualdez in exchange for withholding a video that purportedly links him to irregularities in flood control projects. (Video/NBI)

GINAMIT ANG SASAKYAN NI SEN. ROBIN?

Iginiit ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Sec. Jonvic Remulla na posibleng ginamit umano ni Sen. Bato dela Rosa ang sasakyan ni Sen. Robin Padilla bilang posibleng getaway car.

Kasunod ito ng nangyaring gulo sa Senado kung saan nagkaroon ng putukan ng baril sa loob mismo ng Senate premises.

“This is the picture of the vehicle leaving, a Fortuner that belongs to Sen. Robinhood Padilla,” sabi ni Remulla.

Matatandaang kinumpirma ni Senate Pres. Alan Peter Cayetano na wala na sa Senado si dela Rosa noong Huwebes, May 14.

📸: RTVM

media.ocrText:
APLASCA GAVE “LOCK AND LOAD” ORDER

LOOK: Acting Senate Sergeant-at-Arms Mao Aplasca is seen cocking his firearm in front of security personnel moments before the gun related incident on May 13. 

DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla said that Aplasca had given operatives of the Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms, PNP-PSPG, and the Marines the signal to “lock and load” in front of the media.

"In normal situations, if there is a perceived confrontation, he will clear the building of all personnel because of possible stray fire. However, he allowed them to follow,” Remulla said. | 📸: RTVM

PAGBABAGO SA SENATE LEADERSHIP

Apat na ang nagsilbing Senate presidents mula nang magsimula ang administrasyon ni Pres. Bongbong Marcos noong 2022.

Pinakabago rito si Senate Pres. Alan Peter Cayetano na itinalaga noong nakaraang linggo.

text:
‘LOCK-AND-LOAD ORDER’

Sinabi ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Sec. Jonvic Remulla na inatasan umano ni Senate Sergeant-at-Arms Mao Aplasca ang ilang personnel na mag-assemble, at nagbigay ng "lock-and-load" order bago ang insidente sa Senado.

"At that moment, Gen. Aplasca called in the [Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms] operatives, including the [Philippine National Police], and the Marines, and gave the order to 'lock and load,'" sabi ni Remulla.

📸: RTVM

text:
NAG-YATE NA SI SEN. BATO? 

Llamas on claim that Sen. Bato dela Rosa boarded a yacht to leave the country following his escape from the Senate: Lahat naman ‘yan posible because of a weak government.

Sen. Robin Padilla earlier dismissed rumors that Dela Rosa boarded a plane or yacht, as he kept mum on details about his alleged involvement in the latter’s escape. #TruthOnTheLine

LIVE: https://www.youtube.com/live/3BYrpWbX4WM

media.ocrText: May be an image of text that says 'PHILIPPINE STAR IMPEACHMENT TRIAL, TULOY KAHIT WALA SI SARA DUTERTE'

text:
Nilinaw ni Batangas 2nd district Rep. Gerville Luistro, House lead prosecutor, na matutuloy ang impeachment trial laban kay Vice President Sara Duterte kahit na hindi ito dumalo o hindi magpadala ng defense team. 
 
“Kahit hindi dumating ang Bise Presidente, kahit hindi siya mag-file ng answer, kahit hindi dumating ang defense lawyers nila, tutuloy pa rin ang trial,” saad niya sa press briefing nitong Martes, May 19, 2026. 
 
“Ang magiging effect lang nitong instances na ‘to, it will be considered as an entry of a plea of not guilty,” dagdag niya. 
 
Pormal na nag-convene ang Senado bilang impeachment court nitong Lunes, May 18, 2026.

PANOORIN: https://youtu.be/scMEOa5FcQ8

"Lahat ng legal luminaries, even the Supreme Court sa kanilang obiter noong 2020, unanimously agreed na merong treaty tayo with the ICC na binding. text:
NAMJOON ACTUALLY WENT TO THE CRYING TREE 🥹

LOOK: BTS’ RM recreates the photo of Epik High’s Tablo at Stanford University’s “crying tree,” a spot which gained attention after it served as the backdrop for the latter’s emotional 2010 interview amid a controversy.

During RM’s guest appearance on the hip hop trio’s YouTube show “EPIKASE,” Tablo recommended that the BTS members visit the site to shake off bad luck as they go through a world tour. | 📷: Tablo/Instagram

text:
KATE GIBSON, ITINALAGANG ASSOCIATE COUNSEL NI DUTERTE

Pormal nang inanunsyo ng International Criminal Court (ICC) Registry ang pagtatalaga kay Australian lawyer Kate Gibson bilang associate counsel ni dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte sa kaniyang crimes against humanity case.

Ni-request ng bagong counsel ni Duterte na si Peter Haynes ang appointment ni Gibson noong May 18.

📷: ICC

text:
CCTV FOOTAGE NG KOMOSYON SA PUTUKAN SA SENADO

Ipinakita sa press briefing ng Palasyo, kasama si Interior Sec. Jonvic Remulla, at Philippine National Police (PNP), ang CCTV footage ng pagpapaputok umano ng baril ni Senate Sergeant-at-Arms retired major general Mao Aplasca sa nangyaring gulo sa Senado noong May 13.

text:
24-HOUR PUBLIC WEATHER FORECAST
Issued at 4:00 PM, 19 May 2026

SYNOPSIS: Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) affecting southern Mindanao. Easterlies affecting the eastern sections of Southern Luzon and Visayas.

Forecast Weather Conditions

Area: Zamboanga Peninsula, BARMM, SOCCSKSARGEN, and Davao Occidental
Weather Condition: Cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms
Caused By: ITCZ
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides due to moderate to at times heavy rains

Area: Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, Caraga, and Davao Oriental
Weather Condition: Partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rainshowers or thunderstorms
Caused By: Easterlies
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides during severe thunderstorms

Area: Metro Manila and the rest of the country
Weather Condition: Partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rainshowers or thunderstorms
Caused By: Localized Thunderstorms
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides during severe thunderstorms

text:
🌏The 26th Session of the ASEAN Climate Outlook Forum (ASEANCOF-26) officially kicks off today, bringing together climate experts, meteorological agencies, and stakeholders across Southeast Asia to develop a consensus outlook for the June to August (JJA 2026) season.

Hosted virtually by DOST-PAGASA, this year’s forum carries the theme: “Navigating Our Future, Together: Translating Climate Forecasts into Action.” The event highlights the importance of regional collaboration in strengthening climate services and transforming climate information into actionable decisions for communities and key sectors across ASEAN. 

#ASEANCOF26 #ASEAN #ClimateOutlookForum

text:
‘MAS MASAHOL PA KAY HUDAS’

Ihinalintulad ni Sen. Rodante Marcoleta sa biblical character na si Judas ang sinumang kakalas sa samahan ng majority bloc sa Senado.

Matatandaang nito lamang May 11 nang magkaroon ng leadership change sa Senado kung saan nailuklok sa pwesto si Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano bilang bagong Senate President.

Sa kasalukuyan, 13 ang miyembro ng mayorya. Nadagdagan naman ang minorya matapos umanib sina Sen. Migz Zubiri at Sen. JV Ejercito nitong Lunes, May 18.

text:
Discover astronomy, experience open government 

DOST-PAGASA supports the celebration of the Open Government Week (OGW) on May 18-22, 2026.  

We will be hosting FREE planentarium shows on May 19, 2026 (Tuesday) at 10:00AM and 3:00PM at the PAGASA Science Garden, Quezon City. 

This is a great opportunity to learn more about the wonders of the universe! No reservation required. Walk-ins are welcome on a first-come, first-served basis.

text:
‘KAYA MAHAL ‘YAN NI LORD EH’ 🥹🧡

WATCH: A fur parent from Cebu City brought their seven-year-old cat, Keken, to their family’s bible study, where the fur baby complied attentively. 

Uploader Jason told the Inquirer that they always do bible reading every Sunday, and make Keken participate since it is well-behaved and obedient. 

“[Kasama] siya kasi hindi siya malikot, nakikinig, tapos may treat siya pagkatapos, which is favorite [rin] niya, malambing siyang pusa,” he said. 

He also shared that they rescued Keken from the streets as a kitten, and even though he initially disliked cats, he eventually found himself seeking Keken’s presence regularly. 

“[Noong mag-boyfriend-girlfriend pa kami ng asawa ko, hindi ko talaga gusto ‘yung pusa, ‘yung wife ko lang mahilig, pero ngayon hindi ako makatulog ‘pag hindi ko siya katabi],” he shared. 

📹: Jason (via Edalyn Erandio/INQUIRER.net)

text:
Sec. Remulla: All entrances from GSIS to Senate, since early in the morning were being fortified by the GSIS maintenance. 

They had duly informed the maintenance of the Senate that there was going to be drill work going on in all the doors of GSIS connecting to the Senate... 

The Senate maintenance management had the information that there was going to be fortification of doors in the GSIS area. Hindi gulatan 'to ah... They were duly informed...

text:
‘HINDI PO KAMI NATATAKOT SA SUSUNOD NA ELEKSYON’

‘Yan ang naging sagot ng isa sa mga House prosecutor na si San Juan Rep. Ysabel Maria Zamora nang tanungin kung hindi ba sila natatakot na maaaring mag-reflect sa susunod na eleksyon ang kanilang pagtugis bilang prosecutor sa impeachment trial ni Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

text:
Advancing Regional Resilience through Collaboration 

DOST-PAGASA, in partnership with the UK Met Office, is currently hosting the Weather and Climate Science for Service Partnership – Southeast Asia (WCSSP SeA) Regional Workshop from May 18–21, 2026, in Mactan, Cebu. 

The regional workshop serves as an important platform for scientists, forecasters, and institutional partners across Southeast Asia and the United Kingdom to exchange knowledge, share experiences, and strengthen regional collaboration. It also supports the continued development of joint research initiatives aimed at improving weather and climate models, as well as forecasting capabilities across the region.

This year’s theme, “A Decade of Collaboration in Weather and Climate: From Scientific Innovations to Effective and Actionable Forecast Applications,” highlights ten years of partnership among countries in Southeast Asia and the UK Met Office in advancing the understanding of large-scale and convective-scale weather and climate science. It also emphasizes the importance of translating scientific advancements into effective warnings, forecasts, and actionable advice for communities and decision-makers.

The workshop likewise aims to discuss future plans for ongoing projects within the Southeast Asian region and identify opportunities for collaboration with other potential partners. This partnership further demonstrates the role of DOST-PAGASA as one of the region’s leading institutions in promoting the advancement of weather and climate services.

text:
CHINESE VESSEL OFF THE COAST OF ZAMBALES

WATCH: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) tracked the unauthorized presence of a China Coast Guard vessel within the country’s exclusive economic zone (EEZ) off the coast of Zambales on Tuesday, May 19.

The vessel refused to acknowledge numerous radio challenges issued by PCG aircraft conducting a maritime domain awareness (MDA) flight over the area, according to the PCG.

“These activities constitute a direct violation of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), the Philippine Maritime Zones Act, and the final and binding 2016 Arbitral Award,” PCG spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Commodore Jay Tarriela stated. | 📹: Jay Tarriela/X via Hiroshi Suto, INQUIRER.net trainee

text:
FOR THE QUEEN 👑🎨

WATCH: A 20-year-old artist from Iligan City, Lanao del Norte, expressed his admiration for Miss Universe 2025 third runner-up Ahtisa Manalo by making a realistic portrait of her. 

Chemist Navidad Achondo told the Inquirer that Manalo's journey and experience in competing on the global stage taught him to keep moving forward despite setbacks.

"I believe that she is the epitome of resilience and strength, where she endures failures and tries again the next time around," he explained. 

"This has always been my coping mechanism where I try again and allow the failures to teach me how to transform and be better than I was before," he added. 

Achondo then shared that he had spent six days finishing the art piece and wished it would reach the beauty queen herself. 

"This painting is more than special to me, and I hope this piece could reach Queen Ahtisa's hands. She is not just an inspiration, she is also a history maker," he concluded.

📹: Chemist Navidad Achondo (via Edalyn Erandio/INQUIRER.net)

text:
DRILLING OF SENATE-GSIS DOORS EXPLAINED

DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla said that the Senate maintenance management had already been informed that there would be drilling and fortification of doors leading to the GSIS building on May 13 as part of maintenance operations.  

Remulla added that the GSIS President Wick Veloso ordered the complex to be secured with help from the NBI to protect the artworks inside the building in case unrest broke out, following Sen. Bato dela Rosa’s call for a “people power movement” in his live stream.

“Had there been anarchy in the building, the GSIS contains billions of pesos worth of artworks that are displayed on their walls. Had there been an overflow of people going to GSIS, the losses would have been incredible. So he found it better for them to secure the doors so there would be no commotion going to the GSIS building,” Remulla said. | 📸: RTVM

Watch the live stream here: https://inqnews.net/PalacepressMay19

24-HOUR PUBLIC WEATHER FORECAST
Issued at 4:00 AM, 18 May 2026

SYNOPSIS: Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) affecting southern Mindanao.

Forecast Weather Conditions

Area: Zamboanga Peninsula, BARMM, SOCCSKSARGEN, and Davao Region
Weather Condition: Cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms
Caused By: ITCZ
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides due to moderate to at times heavy rains

Area: Visayas and the rest of Mindanao
Weather Condition: Partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rainshowers or thunderstorms
Caused By: Easterlies
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides during severe thunderstorms

Area: Metro Manila and the rest of Luzon
Weather Condition: Partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rainshowers or thunderstorms
Caused By: Localized Thunderstorms
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides during severe thunderstorms

Forecast Wind and Coastal Water Conditions

Area: Extreme Northern Luzon
Wind Speed: Moderate
Wind Direction: Northeast to East
Coastal Waters: Moderate / (1.2 to 2.5 meters)

Area: The rest of Luzon
Wind Speed: Light to Moderate
Wind Direction: Northeast to North
Coastal Waters: Slight to Moderate / (0.6 to 1.8 meters)

Area: The rest of the country
Wind Speed: Light to Moderate
Wind Direction: East to Northeast
Coastal Waters: Slight to Moderate / (0.6 to 1.2 meters)

text:
‘HINDI KO STYLE ‘YAN’

Ito ang binigyang-diin ni Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima nang tanungin siya kung maituturing niyang “payback” sa mga Duterte ang pagtayo niya bilang isa sa House prosecutors sa impeachment trial ni Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

Ayon kay de Lima, ginagawa niya ang trabaho niya bilang miyembro ng Kamara nang patas.

“Hindi po ako ‘yung nag-e-exhibit ng vendetta… Nakatingin lang po ako lagi sa prinsipyo ng katotohanan at pananagutan,” dagdag niya.

‘UNFORTUNATE DEVELOPMENT’

Senator Jinggoy Estrada maintained he did not push for insertions under the 2025 national budget, saying the charges recommended by state prosecutors against him were “baffling and unjust.”

text:
PETISYON PARA SA PHYSICAL EXAM, DRUG TEST NI PBBM, PINADI-DISMISS SA SC

Pinababasura ng Office of the Solicitor General (OSG) ang petisyong humihiling sa Supreme Court (SC) na obligahin si Pres. Bongbong Marcos na sumailalim sa physical examination, kabilang ang hair follicle drug test, at isapubliko ang kaniyang medical records.

Inihain nina dating House speaker Pantaleon Alvarez at iba pa ang naturang petisyon.

Giit ng OSG, labag sa doctrine ng presidential immunity ang petisyon. Wala rin umanong legal standing ang mga petitioner dahil hindi sapat na botante at taxpayer sila upang magkaroon ng karapatang magsampa ng kaso. | via Camille Samonte

text:
‘NO ATTACK ON THE SENATE’

Iginiit ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Sec. Jonvic Remulla na walang nangyaring pag-atake sa Senado kasunod ng nangyaring gulo sa Senate premises noong May 13.

Sinabi ito ng kalihim base sa isinagawang anim na araw na imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad.

Taliwas ito sa naunang pahayag ni Senate Pres. Alan Peter Cayetano sa insidente.

“The Senate was under attack! [...] You will tell me, 'pag may nagpaputok ng warning [shot], hindi under attack 'yun?” ani Cayetano.

text:
SPOKESPERSONS NG PROSECUTION SA VP SARA TRIAL

Magsisilbi sina 1st District Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Adiong at Kabataan Rep. Renee Co bilang House trial spokespersons para sa gaganaping impeachment trial laban kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

“[Rep. Renee Co] already mentioned publicly that she’s one of the talking heads, and I wish to include the name of [Rep. Zia Adiong]," sabi ni lead prosecutor Rep. Gerville Luistro.

Nito lamang Lunes, May 18, nang mag-convene ang Senado bilang impeachment court.

text:
PALACE PRESS BRIEFING ON SENATE INCIDENT

Nagdaos ng press briefing ang Presidential Communications Office (PCO) kasama ang Philippine National Police (PNP), Department of Justice (DOJ), at Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) ngayong Martes, May 19.

Kaugnay ito ng imbestigasyon sa nangyaring gulo sa Senado noong nakaraang linggo.

LIVE: youtube.com/live/1Yl_dTFiSh0

• Sec. Remulla: All evidence points that there was no attack on the Senate
• PNP chief P/Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez, Jr., ipinakita ang timeline ng tinatawag nilang "gun-related incident" sa Senado
• Sec. Remulla, sinabing alam na ni Pres. Bongbong Marcos ang report sa insidente sa Senado, pero wala pa siyang instructions hinggil dito
• Sec. Vida, natanggap na ang report ng NBI, na itinurn over niya sa DOJ Panel of Prosecutors; Report ni Nartatez, itu-turn over na rin sa DOJ
• Sec. Vida: Compelling 'yung facts but we still need to verify and validate
• Sec. Remulla: When he (NBI director Melvin Matibag) said that there was no NBI agent in the Senate, there was none; They never set foot inside the building; They were in the same complex, but not in the same area
• Sec. Remulla, sinabing nagbigay si Sergeant-at-Arms Mao Aplasca ng "lock-and-load" order bago ang insidente sa Senado

text:
‘I'VE BEEN DOING MY JOB AS A MEMBER OF THIS HOUSE FAIRLY’

Itinanggi ni Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima na ganti niya sa mga Duterte ang pagtayo bilang isa sa House prosecutors sa impeachment trial ni Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

media.ocrText:
‘TUTULOY PA RIN ANG TRIAL’

Lead prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro emphasized that the trial against Vice President Sara Duterte will continue even if she or her legal team doesn’t appear in the Senate or files a reply to the complaints against her. 

The impeachment court will instead enter a “not guilty” plea on behalf of Duterte. 

“Kahit hindi dumating ang bise presidente, kahit ‘di siya mag file ng answer, kahit ‘di dumating ‘yung defense lawyers nila, tutuloy pa rin ang trial,” Luistro said. | 📸: House

Watch the live stream here: https://inqnews.net/Houseprosecution

𝗜𝗕𝗜𝗡𝗔𝗦𝗨𝗥𝗔 𝗡𝗚 𝗣𝗜𝗦𝗞𝗔𝗟𝗬𝗔 

Reklamong frustrated murder at malicious mischief laban sa pulis ng Quezon City Police District, na nanulak ng isang motorcycle rider sa Pasig City, ibinasura ng piskalya. 

Sa halip, sinabi ng abugado ng pulis na si  Ariel Inton na inirekomenda ng piskalya ang slight physical injuries lamang na may piyansang ₱3,000. | via Glen Juego

text:

‘HINDI KO PO STYLE ‘YAN’

Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima clarified that her taking on the role as public prosecutor in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte isn’t a form of revenge against the Dutertes. 

“Hindi po ako yung nage-exhibit ng vendetta, at para sa akin lang po, nakatingin lang po ako palagi sa prinsipyo ng katotohanan at pananagutan. Truth, also justice and accountability,” de Lima said. 

The former senator was arrested in 2017 on drug-trafficking charges during former president Rodrigo Duterte’s administration, which were ultimately dismissed in 2024. | 📸: House

Watch the live stream here: https://inqnews.net/Houseprosecution

Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima clarified that her taking on the role as public prosecutor in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte isn’t a form of revenge against the Dutertes. 

“Hindi po ako yung nage-exhibit ng vendetta, at para sa akin lang po, nakatingin lang po ako palagi sa prinsipyo ng katotohanan at pananagutan. Truth, also justice and accountability,” de Lima said. 

The former senator was arrested in 2017 on drug-trafficking charges during former president Rodrigo Duterte’s administration, which were ultimately dismissed in 2024. | 📸: House

Watch the live stream here: https://inqnews.net/Houseprosecution

text:
IHIHINTO NA ANG SERVICE CONTRACTING PROGRAM

Inanunsyo ng Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) na matatapos na ang Land-Based Service Contracting Program sa Huwebes, May 21.

Ihihinto na ang mga aktibidad na may kinalaman sa implementasyon ng programa, kabilang ang pagbibigay ng 20% hanggang 40% fare discount sa mga pasahero.

Inilunsad ang programa noong April 15 para tulungan ang mga public transport operator at driver sa gitna ng fuel crisis.

#BantayPanahon: (As of 2:20 pm) Asahan ang katamtaman hanggang sa malakas na pag-ulan na may kasamang kidlat at malakas na hangin sa Zambales, Bataan, Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, at Bulacan sa loob ng mga susunod na 2 oras.

‘‘YUNG MGA WFH, NAPIPILITANG MAG-REPORT SA OFFICE DAHIL BROWNOUT’

Nanawagan ang Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) na tuluyan nang ibasura ang Electric Power Industry Reform Act (EPIRA) matapos ang 25 taon nitong pagpapatupad na nagresulta umano sa labis na pagpapahirap sa mga konsumer.

Binatikos din ng grupo ang "pass-through costs" kapag nagmamahal ang imported na coal, at ang "system loss charge" kung saan ang mga konsumer ang nagbabayad sa kuryenteng hindi naman nila nagamit. | via #Vidyolante Eder Del Castillo & Lito Hornedo, News5 Quick Reaction Team

For more latest stories, visit us at www.news5.com.ph

text:
COUPLE GOALS 😍

Actor Troy Montero celebrated his fitness milestones with his wife Aubrey Miles after finishing different sport competitions in the last month. 

"Last 30 Days has been FUN!! 🔥🔥🔥
From our 1st HYROX in Hong Kong last weekend • 4th in age group.
16K Panasonic Run yesterday • 7th in age group
QuakerFit Run April 26 •1st in age group
Sharp Run April 19 •1st in age group
And The Ko’ko’ Road Race in Guam on April 12

Aubrey Miles we put in the work and enjoying the results but now it’s time to recover and get back to training. Where to next? 🔥🔥🔥," he wrote in an Instagram post on Sunday. (Instagram/Troy Montero)

HOUSE PROSECUTION PANEL PREPARATIONS FOR VP SARA TRIAL

Nag-organisa na ng mga grupo ang House prosecution panel na tututok sa bawat isa sa apat na Articles of Impeachment laban kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

text:
'HINDI PO, I'VE BEEN DOING MY JOB AS A MEMBER OF THIS HOUSE FAIRLY'

Ito ang sagot ni Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima sa tanong kung maituturing niyang "payback" laban sa mga Duterte ang pagiging House prosecutor niya sa impeachment ni Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

"Hindi ko po style 'yan... Nakatingin lang po ako lagi sa prinsipyo ng katotohanan at pananagutan," ayon kay de Lima.

text:
CEBU PACIFIC TO RESUME DUBAI OPERATIONS

Inanunsyo ng Cebu Pacific na magbabalik-operasyon na ang kanilang Manila-Dubai-Manila flights simula July 2, 2026.

Magkakaroon sila ng apat na Dubai flights kada linggo — tuwing Martes, Huwebes, Sabado, at Linggo.

text:
HINDI DAHIL SA IMPEACHMENT

Opisyal nang nagbitiw sa pwesto si 1-Tahanan Rep. Nathaniel Oducado dahil aniya sa health reasons at upang magkaroon ng oras sa kaniyang pamilya.

Kasabay nito, mariing itinanggi ni Oducado ang mga espekulasyon na may kinalaman ang kaniyang pag-resign sa kaniyang boto na sumusuporta sa impeachment complaint laban kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

Samantala, pinag-uusapan pa ng partido kung sino ang uupo sa bakanteng pwesto. Ngunit lumulutang na papalit sa kanya ang pangalan ni Brigada Group founder at 1-Tahanan Party-list chairman Elmer Catulcos na siyang 4th nominee ng grupo. | via Marianne Enriquez

text:
NA-MANIFEST ‘YUNG BROWNOUT 😂

Literal na dumilim ang paligid nang kantahin ng contestant sa isang singing contest ang kanyang piyesa dahil sa brownout sa Pura, Tarlac noong May 13.

Noong una ay nalungkot daw siya dahil baka makaapekto ang nangyari sa resulta ng contest. Buti na lang ay pinaulit sa kanya ang kanyang performance matapos maghintay ng ilang oras.

Sa huli ay sulit naman dahil nag-champion ang uploader na kontisero na simula pa noong siya’y 15 years old.

“Madalas po mag-brownout dito gawa ng rotational brownout. Siguro dahil sa mababang supply ng kuryente,” kuwento ng uploader.

“Nagulat ako siyempre nasaktuhan pa na ako kumakanta tapos biglang nawalan ng kuryente,” dagdag pa niya.

🪐 Your next astronomy adventure starts in Cebu!

DOST-PAGASA is excited to host The Southeast Asia Planetarium, Education and Outreach Conference (SEA-PEO) this 23–25 November 2026 in Mactan, Cebu, Philippines 🇵🇭

This regional conference gathers planetarium professionals, astronomy educators, science communicators, outreach personnel, and astronomy enthusiasts from across Southeast Asia to connect, learn, and inspire through the power of astronomy education and public outreach.

🌌 Conference Highlights:
• Engaging the public through planetariums
• Interdisciplinary astronomy
• Astronomy education and communication
• Dark and quiet skies
• Accessibility, diversity, equity, and inclusion in astronomy outreach

text:
'WHAT IS MANDATED TO BE 'FORTHWITH' IS NOT ONLY THE CONVENING, IT IS THE TRIAL'

House lead prosecutor Gerville "Jinky" Luistro called for the immediate start of the impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte, as mandated by the Constitution.

"As we have witnessed yesterday, the impeachment court already convened [...] Nevertheless, let us all be reminded that what is mandated to be 'forthwith' is not only the convening, it is the trial," she stated on Tuesday.

Luistro added that she hopes the proceedings will move swiftly following the pre-trial stage.

"We, therefore, look forward that after the Pre-Trial, we will immediately proceed to the presentation of witnesses, evidence, and consequently to the judgment. By judgment, it is only either acquittal or conviction," she said.

text:
LAGPAS-TUHOD NA BAHA

Muddy at lagpas-tuhod na baha ang sumalubong sa mga residente ng Malolos City, Bulacan matapos ang halos dalawang oras na malakas na buhos ng ulan kagabi, May 18.

Bukod sa ulan, isinisi rin ng mga residente ang perwisyong dulot ng isang tinatambakang bukid na wala umanong kaukulang permit mula sa City Engineering at Planning Office ng Malolos at kawalan ng maayos na drainage system.

Umaapela ngayon ng agarang aksyon at tulong ang mga residente sa lokal na pamahalaan. | via Thony Arcenal

'WE COMMEND THE ACTION OF THE SENATE'

Ito ang saad ni House lead prosecutor at 2nd District Batangas Rep. Jinky Luistro kasunod ng pag-convene ng Senado bilang impeachment court nitong Lunes, May 18.

"The impeachment court already convened and we commend the action of the Senate of the Philippines for responding to the mandate of the constitution," saad ni Rep. Luistro sa isang press conference ngayong Martes, May 19.

text:
HOUSE APPOINTS PROSECUTORS TO LEAD PRESENTATION OF ARTICLES OF IMPEACHMENT VS VP SARA 

House lead prosecutor and Batangas 2nd district Representative Gerville Luistro announces the assignment of House prosecutors in the presentation of the four Articles of Impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte. 

Here are the prosecutors who will lead the presentation for each article:

• Confidential funds: Rep. Jinky Luistro
• Unexplained wealth: Rep. Terry Ridon
• Bribery: Rep. Joel Chua
• Threats and destabilization: Rep. Lorenz Defensor 

Yesterday, May 18, 2026, the Senate officially convened as an impeachment court following receipt of the Articles of Impeachment from the House of Representatives.

text:
'WHY FOCUS SOLELY ON DAVAO?'

Davao City First District Representative Paolo Duterte issued a statement calling ACT Representative Antonio Tinio "selectively blind" on Tuesday.

This follows Tinio's submission of a complaint against Duterte before the Office of the Ombudsman over alleged irregularities in more than 80 flood control projects.

"Why is Mr. Tinio selectively blind? Why is he not filing complaints against the engineers, contractors, and political personalities linked to questionable flood control projects nationwide? Why focus solely on Davao while conveniently ignoring the larger controversies hounding the present administration and its allies," he emphasized.

"Instead of acknowledging actual infrastructure accomplishments, 'Tontong Tinio' appears more interested in recycling troll narratives and politically motivated accusations meant to demonize the Duterte family," he claimed. (Facebook/Congressman Paolo “Pulong” Duterte)

text:
Cebu Pacific announced on Tuesday that it will resume its Dubai operations starting July 2, 2026, following safety assessments and coordination with Dubai airport authorities.

The following flights will resume operations:

• 5J 14/15: Manila – Dubai – Manila
• 5J 18/19: Manila – Dubai – Manila

Flights between Manila and Dubai will operate four times weekly — every Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, and Sunday.

Passengers affected by cancelled Dubai flights may rebook through the Manage Booking portal on the Cebu Pacific website. | via Rudy Santos

text:
NI-REJECT NG PILIPINAS

Hindi pinagbigyan ng Pilipinas ang hiling ng Estados Unidos na isailalim ang planong 1,619-hectare na artificial intelligence hub sa American law at bigyan ng diplomatic immunity ang U.S. personnel sa site.

Kinumpirma ito ni Bases Conversion and Development Authority president Joshua Bingcang, kasabay ng pagbisita ni U.S. Undersecretary of State for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg sa future site ng AI hub sa Tarlac.

"It will be treated as a regular business development contract. No special treatment to be accorded to the U.S.," saad ni Bingcang. | via Philstar.com

Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla joined local officials from Imus and General Trias, Cavite on Tuesday for the inspection and ceremonial walk-through of the newly completed Imus-GenTri Friendship Bridge 1.

The two-lane, 40-meter bridge links Barangay Alapan 2-B in Imus City to Barangay Navarro in General Trias and is expected to improve traffic flow and shorten travel time between the neighboring Cavite cities. (Photos by Edd Gumban/The Philippine STAR)

text:
SUCH A LOVELY FAMILY! ❤️

Professional photographer Andreus Gabrielle Lopez shared heartwarming family photos of Jimuel Pacquiao, his partner Carolina, and their child Clara on Tuesday.

"Welcome to the world baby Clara. These are the moments we’ll always come back to," he wrote in his post.

Clara is the first grandchild of boxing legend and former senator Manny Pacquiao. (Instagram/Andreus Gabrielle Lopez)

SAN DIEGO SHOOTING

Lima ang patay sa pamamaril sa Islamic Center sa San Diego, California nitong Lunes, May 18.

Kabilang sa mga nasawi ang dalawang teenage gunmen, isang security guard, at dalawa pang iba.

Iniimbestigahan na ng mga awtoridad ang nangyaring pag-atake bilang posibleng hate crime. | via Reuters

text:
BAKIT NAG-RESIGN SI ODUCADO?

Kalusugan at pamilya ang dahilan ng pagbibitiw ni Nathaniel Oducado bilang kinatawan ng 1Tahanan Party-list.

Paliwanag ni Oducado, nakaranas siya ng hilo at pagod dahil sa walang-tigil na kampanya at trabaho mula pa noong 2024.

Pinabulaanan niya ang mga ispekulasyong may koneksyon ang kaniyang boto sa impeachment complaint ni Vice Pres. Sara Duterte sa kaniyang resignation.

Tinawag din niyang "fake news" ang mga ulat na nakatanggap ang mga kongresista ng P20 million kapalit ng suporta sa impeachment. | via Marianne Enriquez

text: House Minority Leader and ACT Teachers Partylist Rep. Antonio Tinio files a complaint before the Office of the Ombudsman in Quezon City on Tuesday against Davao City Rep. Paolo “Pulong” Duterte over alleged irregularities tied to more than 80 flood control projects worth P4.44 billion along the Davao and Matina rivers from 2019 to 2022. (Photos by Michael Varcas/The Philippine STAR)

text:
WEATHER UPDATE

Posibleng makaranas ng katamtaman hanggang malakas na pag-ulan na may kasamang pagkidlat at malakas na bugso ng hangin ang ilang lugar sa susunod na dalawang oras, batay sa 1:50 p.m. thunderstorm advisory ng PAGASA ngayong Martes, May 19.

• Cavite (Tagaytay, Silang, Amadeo, Indang, Mendez, Alfonso)
• Pampanga (Porac, Angeles, Mabalacat)
• Zambales (Botolan, Iba, Cabangan, San Antonio, San Narciso, San Felipe, Castillejos, San Marcelino)
• Nueva Ecija (General Tinio, Gabaldon)
• Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad)

Nararanasan ang naturang kondisyon sa sumusunod na lugar na maaaring magpatuloy sa susunod na dalawang oras at makaapekto sa mga kalapit na lugar.

• Tarlac (Bamban, Capas)
• Laguna (Rizal, San Pablo)
• Quezon (Dolores, Unisan, Agdangan, Macalelon, General Luna, Catanauan)
• Batangas (Calaca, Balayan, Tuy)

‘ANG UNANG SUSPENDIHIN DAPAT, SI SEN. ALAN PETER CAYETANO DAHIL COMMAND RESPONSIBILITY NIYA SI SERGEANT-AT-ARMS’

Pinalagan ni National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Atty. Melvin Matibag ang apela ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano sa Ombudsman na patawan ito ng suspensyon tulad ng ginawa kay Senate acting sergeant-at-arms Mao Aplasca.

Giit ni Matibag, dapat si Cayetano ang patawan ng suspensyon dahil sa nangyaring gulo sa Senado. | via Gio Robles

text:
Manila Mayor Isko Moreno, joined by Vice Mayor Chi Atienza and Manila Police District (MPD) Director Brig. Gen. Arnold Santiago, turns over donated motorcycles to the MPD at the Manila City Hall on Tuesday.

The motorcycles will be distributed to police stations across the city to strengthen patrol mobility and improve emergency response operations. (Photos by Edd Gumban/The Philippine STAR)

text:
Residents of Panukulan received free medical services from the “Kalinga sa Mamamayan, Libreng Gamutan” program of the Provincial Government of Quezon on Tuesday.

The outreach program provides free medical consultation, medicines, check-ups, and other healthcare assistance to residents as part of the provincial government’s continuing effort to improve access to healthcare, especially in remote island municipalities. | via Michelle Zoleta

Ang nangyari ngayon, it's the NBI [that] is under attack. ATTY. MELVIN MATIBAG Director, NBI May 19, 2026 Sa Sapahayag SP SP Cayetano πa inatake umano ang Senado NEWS 5'

text:
NBI ANG ‘UNDER ATTACK?’

Pinabulaanan ni National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Atty. Melvin Matibag ang pahayag ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano na “under attack” umano ang Senado matapos ang gulo rito noong May 13.

Nauna nang inamin ng sinuspendeng Senate Sergeant-at-Arms na si Mao Aplasca na siya ang unang nagpaputok ng baril matapos niyang mapansin ang isang ahente ng NBI sa ikalawang palapag ng bridgeway na nagdudugtong sa Senado at GSIS building.

Giit pa ni Atty Matibag, kung totoong inatake ang Senado, bakit hindi raw agad nag-evacuate ang mga senador. | via Gio Robles

REKLAMO VS REP. PULONG DUTERTE

WAVE TO EARTH IS COMING TO PH! 🇵🇭

Live Nation PH announced that South Korean indie rock band wave to earth is coming to the Philippines for their "the ( ) pieces tour" at the SM Mall of Asia Arena on November 15, 2026.

Ticket prices range from P2,950 (Box Regular) to P8,750 (VIP A Premium).

Ticket presale is to commence on May 25, 2026, while general onsale will be available on May 26, 2026. (Instagram/Live Nation PH)

text:
‘WHY IS MR. TINIO SELECTIVELY BLIND?’

Kinuwestiyon ni Davao City 1st District Rep. Paolo Duterte ang hakbang ni ACT Teachers Party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio na paimbestigahan ang P4.4 na bilyong halaga ng flood control projects sa Davao City.

"'Tontong Tinio' appears more interested in recycling troll narratives and politically motivated accusations meant to demonize the Duterte family," giit ni Duterte.

Nagtungo si Tinio sa Office of the Ombudsman ngayong Martes, May 19, para paimbestigahan ang 80 umanong maanomalyang flood control projects sa Davao City mula 2019 hanggang 2022.

media.ocrText: May be an image of text

text:
PINAIIMBESTIGAHAN SA OMBUDSMAN

Hinimok ni House Deputy Minority Leader at ACT Teachers Party-List Rep. Antonio Tinio ang Office of the Ombudsman na imbestigahan ang P4.4 na bilyon umanong maanomalyang flood control projects sa Davao at Matina River.

Nagsumite si Rep. Tinio ng mga dokumento, materyales, at House Resolution sa Ombudsman ngayong Martes, May 19.

text:
WEATHER UPDATE

Posibleng makaranas ng malakas na pag-ulan na may kasamang pagkidlat at malakas na bugso ng hangin ang ilang lugar sa susunod na dalawang oras, batay sa 10:14 a.m. thunderstorm advisory ng PAGASA ngayong Martes, May 19.

• Zambales (San Antonio, Subic, Olongapo)
• Cavite (Imus, General Trias, Rosario, Noveleta, Cavite City, Kawit, Bacoor, Tanza, Dasmarinas, Trece Martires, Magallanes, Maragondon, Ternate, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Naic)
• Laguna (Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Pagsanjan, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan)
• Rizal (Tanay, Pililla, Antipolo, Baras, Rodriguez)
• Metro Manila (Las Pinas, Muntinlupa)
• Nueva Ecija (General Tinio)
• Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte)
• Batangas(Nasugbu)

Nararanasan ang naturang kondisyon sa Bataan (Mariveles, Limay, Orion, Bagac) at Quezon (Infanta, Real, Mauban) na maaring magpatuloy sa susunod na dalawang oras at makaapekto sa mga kalapit na lugar.

text:
BUWELTA KAY SEN. CAYETANO

Pumalag si National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Atty. Melvin Matibag sa apela ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano sa Ombudsman na suspendehin si Matibag matapos mapatawan ng anim na buwang suspensyon si Senate Sergeant-at-Arms Mao Aplasca.

Matatandaan na isinailalim sa protective custody ng Senado si Sen. Bato dela Rosa pero kalaunan ay nakatakas madaling araw noong May 14.

Muling iginiit ni Matibag na tumupad sila sa "gentleman’s agreement" nito kay SP Cayetano na hindi nila huhulihin si dela Rosa.

"I kept my promise na 'di kami papasok. But they did not keep their promise that they will take care of Sen. Bato dela Rosa," saad ni Atty. Matibag. | via Gio Robles

text:
NASAAN SI SEN. BATO?

May impormasyon ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) sa kinaroroonan ni Sen. Bato dela Rosa ilang araw matapos itong umalis sa Senate premises noong Huwebes, May 14.

Ayon kay NBI Director Atty. Melvin Matibag, hindi muna nila isisiwalat ang natanggap na leads tungkol dito.

“But again, sinabi ko naman ‘yun, if there's somebody who is a person that should be asked, ang unang unang dapat tanungin [ay] si Senator Robin Padilla dahil siya ‘yung huling kasama,” saad niya. | via Camille Samonte

text:
BALIK SA PAGTATAGO SI SEN. BATO

Dinepensahan ni Atty. Jimmy Bondoc, legal counsel ni Sen. Bato Dela Rosa kung bakit patuloy na nagtatago ang kanyang kliyente sa gitna ng paglutang ng arrest warrant mula sa International Criminal Court (ICC).

Itinanggi rin ni Bondoc na staged o planado ang nangyaring putukan sa pagitan ng OSAA at mga tauhan ng National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) sa Senado noong May 13.

text:
PAGHAHANAP KAY SEN. BATO DELA ROSA

Tinutunton na ng National Bureau of Investigation ang posibleng kinaroroonan ni Sen. Bato Dela Rosa matapos itong lumabas sa protective custody ng Senado noong madaling araw ng May 14.

Ayon kay NBI Director Atty. Melvin Matibag, si Sen. Robin Padilla ang dapat tanungin kung saan ngayon namamalagi ang senador dahil sila ang huling magkasama.

Tumanggi namang magbigay ng impormasyon si Matibag kung aarestuhin si Dela Rosa kung sakaling matunton ito, dahil baka mabulilyaso aniya ang kanilang plano.

text:
LACSON SA PAG-CONVENE NG SENADO BILANG IMPEACHMENT COURT

Nanawagan si Sen. Ping Lacson sa publiko na maging mapagmatyag kasunod ng pag-convene ng Senado bilang impeachment court para sa kaso ni Vice Pres. Sara Duterte nitong Lunes, May 18.

“The stark contrast between the smell of gunpowder last week and the breath of fresh air in the Senate yesterday was evident when we convened as an impeachment court after all the parliamentary procedures were strictly followed,” saad ng Senador.

Opisyal nang iniakyat sa Senado ang Articles of Impeachment laban sa Bise noong May 13.

text:
WORK SUSPENSION SA RTC AT MTCCs DAVAO CITY

Suspendido ang trabaho sa Regional Trial Court at Municipal Trial Courts in Cities sa Davao City dahil sa masamang panahon ngayong Martes, May 19. 

Suspendido rin ang filing ng time-bound pleadings at pag-isyu ng time-bound resolutions at decisions hanggang sa pagbabalik ng normal court operations.

Hindi kasama sa suspension ang mga kailangan ng immediate court action gaya ng applications for bail, release orders, writs of habeas corpus, at iba pa.

Magkakaroon pa rin ng sapat na staff ang mga korte para tumugon sa mga urgent request.

📸: Supreme Court PH

text:
Ikinararangal ng DOST-PAGASA ang mga kawani nitong kinilala bilang Regional Qualifiers sa 2026 Gawad Lingkod Bayani Regional Qualifiers Awarding Ceremony ng Civil Service Commission - National Capital Region.

Kabilang dito si Ms. Ana Liza S. Solis, Chief ng Climate Monitoring and Prediction Section (CLIMPS) ng Climatology and Agrometeorology Division (CAD), bilang Gawad Lingkod Bayan ng Pangulo Regional Qualifier (Individual Category) para sa kanyang ambag sa pagbibigay ng napapanahong impormasyon ukol sa El Niño/La Niña at klima ng bansa.

Regional Qualifier din sa Gawad Pagasa Award ang PAGASA SpillDrift Development Team ng Weather Division na binubuo nina Engr. Christopher Perez, Mr. Robb Gile, at Mr. John Carlo Sugui para sa kanilang pagbuo ng SpillDrift, ang kauna-unahang operational oil spill trajectory forecasting system ng pamahalaan, na syang ginamit noong MT Terranova oil spill incident noong 2024.

Ipinapaabot ng DOST-PAGASA ang pagbati sa mga lingkod-bayang ito na patuloy na nagbibigay ng karangalan sa ahensya sa pamamagitan ng kanilang dedikasyon at mahusay na serbisyo publiko.

text:
‘KUNG HINDI SIYA TUMAKBO, HINDI NATIN SIYA HAHABULIN’

Napilitang habulin ng mga tauhan ng National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) si Sen. Bato Dela Rosa dahil naunang tumakbo ang senador noong May 11, ayon kay NBI Director Atty. Melvin Matibag.

Giit ng NBI, plano lang daw sana nilang ipaalam kay Dela Rosa na may arrest warrant mula sa International Criminal Court (ICC) laban sa kanya bago nagsimula ang habulan.

text:
CYBER WARRANT VS. FRANCO MABANTA

Aprubado na ang cyber warrant para mabuksan at ma-access ang laman ng gadgets ni Peanut Gallery Media Network (PGMN) Founder Franco Mabanta, ayon kay National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Atty. Melvin Matibag.

Uungkatin dito ang mga larawan, videos, text messages, at text logs at malalaman ang mga nakausap na personalidad ni Mabanta.

Naaresto si Mabanta kaugnay ng umano'y extortion plot laban kay dating House speaker Martin Romualdez.

text:
‘HOLDING POWER TO ACCOUNT'

READ: The De La Salle University (DLSU) Committee on National Issues and Concerns issues a statement on the recent development in the Philippine government.

“Recent events are once again calling us to confront deep wounds in our nation’s life: the uneven hand of justice, the evasion of accountability, and the unabated greed and lust for power of the ruling few that have long deprived Filipinos of the dignity, protection, and services that we truly deserve,” it reads.

DLSU calls on Filipinos to “be critical in scrutinizing our leaders” and “speak out” for those who suffer most from the injustice, abuse of power, and corruption. | 📷: DLSU/Facebook via Hiroshi Suto, INQUIRER.net trainee

HINDI CONSISTENT ANG DAHILAN NI SEN. BATO

Pinuna ng Malacañang ang idinahilan ni Sen. Bato dela Rosa kung bakit muli itong pumasok sa Senado, kasabay ng nangyaring pagpapalit ng liderato sa mataas na kapulungan noong May 11.

Hindi raw kasi nagtutugma ang naunang dahilan ni Dela Rosa sa tila palihim na pag-alis nito sa protective custody ng Senado.

Nananatili naman ang posisyon ng Palasyo na hindi makikialam sa paglilitis ng Senado articles of impeachment laban kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

text:
'IT'S NOT ALL ABOUT HIM'

Sinagot ni National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Atty. Melvin Matibag ang pahayag ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano na bigo umano ang NBI na tibagin ang Senado sa ilalim ng pamumuno ng senador.

“Bakit naman natin titibagin? We are there to promote law and order, not in the Senate because I have a commitment that we will not enter the Senate premises,” saad ni Atty. Matibag sa isang panayam ngayong Lunes, May 19.

“This is not about Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano or about me... This is about the rule of law and law and order,” dagdag niya.

text:
NBI DRIVER-VOLUNTEER, PANSAMANTALANG NAKALAYA

Iginiit ng 44-anyos na NBI driver-volunteer na hindi siya nakipagpalitan ng putok sa mga miyembro ng OSAA sa loob ng Senado noong May 13.

Depensa niya, wala siyang hawak na baril at bumalik lamang sa gusali ng GSIS gamit ang kaniyang motorsiklo para kunin ang naiwang bag ng isang kasamahan na naglalaman ng mga mahahalagang gamot.

Pansamantala siyang nakalaya matapos magpiyansa. Pinag-aaralan na rin ng kampo nila ang pagsasampa ng kaso laban sa mga umaresto sa kanya. | via Nina Ongpauco

text:
FINALLY, THE WAIT IS OVER! 😭🖤

The hit Korean fantasy series "Moving" is officially returning for a second season, with Disney+ unveiling a table of returning and new cast members.

"As the world kept moving, so did they," the streaming giant wrote in its Facebook post.

Based on Kang Full’s popular webtoon, “Moving” follows teenagers with hidden superpowers inherited from their parents, who are former secret agents carrying painful pasts.

Returning for Season 2 are stars Ryu Seung Ryong, Han Hyo Joo, Zo In Sung, Cha Tae Hyun, Go Youn Jung, Kim Do Hoon, and Ryu Seung Bum.

New faces include Seol Kyung Gu, Lee Hee Joon, Ryu Hye Young, Roh Yoon Seo, Kim Sung Kyu, Kim Gun Woo, Choi Yoon Ji, and rookie actor Won Gyu Bin, who is reportedly taking over the role of Kim Bong Seok following Lee Jung Ha’s military enlistment. (Facebook/Disney+)

text:
YELLOW ALERT SA VISAYAS GRID

Isasailalim sa yellow alert ang Visayas grid mula 3 p.m. hanggang 9 p.m. ngayong Martes, May 19.

Itinataas ang yellow alert kapag hindi sapat ang operating margin para punan ang contingency requirement ng transmission grid.

Ayon sa National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP), kabilang sa mga dahilan ng pagdeklara ng yellow alert sa Visayas grid ang mataas na demand at unavailability ng large coal plants.

📸: NGCP/ Facebook

text:
SERVICE CONTRACTING PROGRAM, MATATAPOS NA SA MAY 21 — LTFRB

Inanunsyo ng Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) na matatapos na sa May 21 ang Land-Based Service Contracting Program. 

Kasunod nito, ihihinto na rin ang lahat ng aktibidad na may kinalaman sa implementasyon ng programa.

text: Hihimayin at bubusisiin na nina Connie Sison at Arnold Clavio ang pinaka-pinag-uusapang mga balita sa #OneOnOneWalangPersonalan.

Walang kaso ng Ebola virus at hantavirus sa Pilipinas.

Ayon kay Dr. Rontgene Solante, isang infectious disease expert, nagkaroon na noon ng kaso ng Ebola virus sa bansa pero hindi katulad ng virus na nagdudulot ngayon ng outbreak sa ilang lugar sa Africa.

text:
UPDATE SA BULKANG MAYON

Nakapagtala ang PHIVOLCS ng 31 volcanic earthquakes, 21 volcanic tremors, at 287 rockfall events sa Bulkang Mayon ngayong Martes, May 19.

Naitala rin sa bulkan ang 14 na pyroclastic density current signals, lava effusion, at lava flow.

Nananatiling nakataas ang Alert Level 3 sa bulkan dahil sa patuloy na aktibidad nito.

text:
WEATHER UPDATE

Mas mapapadalas na ang pag-ulan simula sa susunod na linggo dahil sa inaasahang pag-iral ng southwesterly wind. Magtutuloy-tuloy na ito hanggang sa pagpasok ng tag-ulan sa Hunyo. Sa ngayon, patuloy na nagdadala ng mainit at maalinsangang panahon ang easterlies.

text: President Marcos took a swipe at Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday, stressing that his administration “never sleeps, never takes vacations” as it works to respond to the needs of the people amid their strained relationship. https://tinyurl.com/yvdpjt5k

Tinawag ng isang law expert na kalokohan ang sinasabi ng kampo ni Sen. Ronald dela Rosa na kailangan muna ng warrant of arrest mula sa lokal na korte bago maipatupad ang waraant of arrest ng International Criminal Court (ICC).

Ayon kay Atty. Jose Roy III, dating pangulo at law dean ng Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Maynila (PLM), malinaw na nakasaad sa Rome Statute na maaari lang dalhin sa lokal na korte ang kaso kapag naaresto na ang indibiduwal na may ICC warrant.

Aniya, dapat magpaaresto muna si dela Rosa bago ito dumulog sa lokal na korte.

text:
𝗠𝗔𝗟𝗔𝗟𝗔 𝗣𝗔 𝗞𝗔𝗬 𝗛𝗨𝗗𝗔𝗦 𝗔𝗡𝗚 𝗞𝗔𝗞𝗔𝗟𝗔𝗦

Masahol pa kay hudas ang sinumang kakalas sa 13 miyembro ngayon ng Senate Majority bloc at may hawak ng liderato ng Senado.

Ito ang idiniin ni Sen. Rodante Marcoleta, na naglahad na nanggaling ang pananalitang ito kay Sen. Camille Villar na isa sa mga kasama niya noong Miyerkules ng gabi nang magkabarilan sa Senado dahil sa umano’y tangkang pag-aresto kay Sena. Ronald dela Rosa.

Ayon kay Marcoleta, nagsakripisyo si dela Rosa para makuha ng kanilang grupo ang liderato ng Senado kaya sino aniya ang walang konsensiya na babalewala rito.

WALANG HAWAK NA BARIL?

Itinanggi ng inarestong driver-volunteer ng National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) na namaril siya nang mangyari ang gulo sa Senate premises noong Miyerkules, May 13.

“May briefing ang mga ahente so more or less mga 30 minutes may naiwang bag sa isa sa sasakyan ng mga kasamahan namin at kailangan makuha kasi may gamot na laman… Bumalik ako mag-isa dala ‘yung personal na motorsiklo papuntang GSIS building,” paliwanag ng driver.

Pinag-aaralan na ng kanyang kampo ang pagsampa ng reklamo laban sa mga umaresto sa kanya. | via Nina Ongpauco

text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 9F
Low Pressure Area (formerly #CaloyPH)
Issued at 11:00 PM, 11 May 2026

“CALOY” WEAKENED INTO A LOW PRESSURE AREA.

Location of Center (10:00 PM): The Low Pressure Area (formerly CALOY) was estimated based on all available data at 600 km East of Guiuan, Eastern Samar or 630 km East of Borongan City, Eastern Samar (11.8°N, 130.0°E). 

Intensity: Central pressure of 1004 hPa

Present Movement: East northeastward at 10 km/h

TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNALS (TCWS) IN EFFECT
No Wind Signal is currently hoisted

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS
The Low Pressure Area is less likely to bring heavy rainfall in any parts of the country.
HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS
24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.0 m: The seaboards of Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela, Aurora, and Surigao del Sur; the northern seaboards of Camarines Norte and Camarines Sur; the northern and eastern seaboards of Quezon including Polillo Islands, Catanduanes, and Northern Samar; the eastern seaboards of Albay, Sorsogon, Eastern Samar, Dinagat Islands, and Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands.
• Mariners of motorbancas and similarly sized vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK
CALOY weakened into a low pressure area at 8:00 PM today. The remnant low will move generally northward or northeastward over the Philippine Sea. As it moves over increasingly less favorable environmental conditions, there is a likelihood that it may dissipate within the next 5 days.

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

Unless re-development occur, this is the final bulletin for this weather disturbance.
 
 
DOST-PAGASA

text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 8
Tropical Depression #CaloyPH (HAGUPIT)
Issued at 5:00 PM, 11 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next bulletin at 11:00 PM today.

“CALOY” MAINTAINS ITS STRENGTH AND IS MOVING NORTHWARD WHILE OVER THE SEA EAST OF EASTERN VISAYAS.

• Location of Center (4:00 PM)
 
The center of Tropical Depression CALOY was estimated based on all available data at 470 km East of Guiuan, Eastern Samar (11.8°N, 130.0°E). 

• Intensity 

Maximum sustained winds of 45 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 55 km/h, and central pressure of 1004 hPa 

• Present Movement 
Northward at 10 km/h 

• Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds 
Strong winds extend outwards up to 250 km from the center

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS
➣CALOY is unlikely to directly affect the country throughout the forecast period.

HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS
➣24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.0 m: The seaboards of Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela, Aurora, and Surigao del Sur; the northern seaboards of Camarines Norte and Camarines Sur; the northern and eastern seaboards of Quezon including Polillo Islands, Catanduanes, and Northern Samar; the eastern seaboards of Albay, Sorsogon, Eastern Samar, Dinagat Islands, and Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands.
• Mariners of motorbancas and similarly sized vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK

• CALOY will continue moving generally northwestward in the next 12 hours and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. 
• This weather disturbance is forecast to further weaken into a remnant low tonight or tomorrow early morning.

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

The next tropical cyclone bulletin will be issued at 11:00 PM today.
 
DOST-PAGASA 

Link: tinyurl.com/CaloyPH

SITWASYON SA MAYON

Ibinahagi ng DOST-PHIVOLCS ang sped-up camera footage ng lava effusion with collapse-fed pyroclastic density currents (PDCs) mula sa crater sa Mi-isi gully sa Mayon Volcano 9:46 p.m. ngayong Lunes, May 18.

Ayon sa ahensya, nagpapatuloy ang effusive eruption sa Mayon sa ika-133 sunod na araw.

Nananatiling nakataas ang Alert Level 3 sa bulkan at ipinagbabawal ang pagpasok sa loob ng 6-km Permanent Danger Zone (PDZ).

📸: DOST-PHIVOLCS

text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 7
Tropical Depression #CaloyPH (HAGUPIT)
Issued at 11:00 AM, 11 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next bulletin at 5:00 PM today.

TROPICAL DEPRESSION CALOY SLOWS DOWN AS IT CONTINUES MOVING WEST-NORTHWESTWARD OVER THE PHILIPPINE SEA.

• Location of Center (10:00 AM)
 
The center of Tropical Depression CALOY was estimated based on all available data at 475 km East of Guiuan, Eastern Samar (10.9°N, 130.1°E). 

• Intensity 

Maximum sustained winds of 45 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 55 km/h, and central pressure of 1004 hPa 

• Present Movement 
West northwestward at 10 km/h 

• Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds 
Strong winds extend outwards up to 250 km from the center

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS
➣CALOY is unlikely to directly affect the country throughout the forecast period.

HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS
➣24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.0 m: The seaboards of Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela, Ilocos Norte, northern Ilocos Sur, Aurora, Camarines Norte, Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, and Surigao del Sur; the western seaboard of Pangasinan; the northern seaboards of Camarines Sur; the northern and eastern seaboards of Quezon including Polillo Islands and Catanduanes; the eastern seaboards of Albay, Sorsogon, Dinagat Islands, Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands, and Davao Oriental.
• Mariners of motorbancas and similarly sized vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK

• CALOY will continue moving west northwestward in the next 12 hours and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. 
• This weather disturbance is forecast to further weaken into a remnant low today (11 May).

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

The next tropical cyclone bulletin will be issued at 5:00 PM today.
 
DOST-PAGASA 

Link: tinyurl.com/CaloyPH

text:
'WE HAVE A COMMITMENT TO THE ICC'

Ito ang tugon ni National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag ukol sa patuloy nitong pagtugis kay Sen. Bato dela Rosa matapos umano itong mamataan sa Batangas.

Nilinaw ni Matibag na patuloy ang monitoring ng mga awtoridad sa kinaroroonan ni Senator dela Rosa lalo na't kasama na siya sa wanted list ng International Criminal Court (ICC).

text:
‘NAKITA NAMAN PO NATIN NA GUMUGULONG NA PO ANG HUSTISYA’

Ito ang komento ni 3rd District Manila Rep. Joel Chua kasunod ng pag-convene ng Senado bilang impeachment court ngayong Lunes, May 18, para sa paglilitis kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

Ayon kay Chua, miyembro ng 11-member House prosecution team, nakatutuwa na nagawa na rin pati ang presentation ng articles ng impeachment at may order na para sa pag-isyu ng writ of summons laban sa bise.

Matatandaang nai-transmit sa Senado ang Articles of Impeachment laban kay VP Duterte noong Miyerkules, May 13.

𝗘𝗝𝗘𝗥𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗢, 𝗭𝗨𝗕𝗜𝗥𝗜, 𝗦𝗨𝗠𝗔𝗟𝗜 𝗦𝗔 𝗠𝗜𝗡𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗧𝗬

Hindi man nagpalit ng liderato, nagpahayag sina Sen. JV Ejercito at Sen. Juan Miguel Zubiri na sasama na sila sa minorya.   

Nabatid na nag-abstain sila nang magbotohan para sa Senate President noong nakaraang linggo. 

Inamin din ni Ejercito na inalok siya ni Cayetano na maging Senate Majority Leader, kapalit ng pagsama sa mayorya.

Sa ngayon, may 13 miyembro ang mayorya, habang 11 ang minorya na pinamumunuan ni Sen. Vicente Sotto III. 

Itinanggi naman ni Sotto III na nagpulong sila ng mga kasamahan ng minorya kaugnay ng pagpalit ng liderato sa Senado.

Without the treaty what will be the legal basis of a warrani of arrest? You tell me. SEN. ROD RODANTE MARCOLETA May 18, 2026 NEWS 5'

text:
‘WHAT WILL BE THE LEGAL BASIS OF THE WARRANT OF ARREST?’

Kinuwestyon ni Sen. Rodante Marcoleta kung ano ang magiging legal na basehan sa pagpapatupad ng isang warrant of arrest mula International Criminal Court (ICC) gayong wala nang membership ang bansa sa Rome Statute.

“Huwag kayong nagpapapaniwala doon sa mga dean, mga abogadong [salita] nang salita. Nililinlang lang nila kayo,” sabi ni Marcoleta ngayong Lunes, May 18.

Nito lamang nakaraang linggo nang kumpirmahin ng ICC ang arrest warrant laban kay Sen. Bato dela Rosa kaugnay ng kasong crimes against humanity of murder.

text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 6
Tropical Depression #CaloyPH (HAGUPIT)
Issued at 5:00 AM, 11 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next bulletin at 11:00 AM today.

TROPICAL DEPRESSION CALOY CONTINUES TO MOVE WEST NORTHWESTWARD WHILE OVER THE PHILIPPINE SEA.

Location of Center (4:00 AM):
The center of Tropical Depression CALOY was estimated based on all available data at 530 km East of Guiuan, Eastern Samar (10.8°N, 130.6°E).

Intensity:
Maximum sustained winds of 45 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 55 km/h, and central pressure of 1004 hPa

Present Movement:
West northwestward at 15 km/h

Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds:
Strong winds extend outwards up to 250 km from the center

TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNALS (TCWS) IN EFFECT

➣ No Wind Signal is currently hoisted

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS

➣ CALOY is unlikely to directly affect the country throughout the forecast period.

HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS

➣ 24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.0 m: The seaboards of Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela, Ilocos Norte, northern Ilocos Sur, Aurora, Camarines Norte, Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, and Surigao del Sur; the western seaboard of Pangasinan; the northern seaboards of Camarines Sur; the northern and eastern seaboards of Quezon including Polillo Islands and Catanduanes; the eastern seaboards of Albay, Sorsogon, Eastern Samar, Dinagat Islands, Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands, and Davao Oriental.
• Mariners of motorbancas and similarly sized vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK

➣ CALOY will continue moving west northwestward in the next 12 hours and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. This weather disturbance is forecast to further weaken into a remnant low today (11 May).

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

The next tropical cyclone bulletin will be issued at 11:00 AM today.

DOST-PAGASA

'KUNG SINABI NI BATO KUMAIN SIYA NG T*E, KAKAIN SIYA NG T*E?’

Hindi umubra kay Sen. Rodante Marcoleta ang dahilan ni dating senador Sonny Trillanes kung bakit siya kasama sa pag-serve ng arrest warrant kay Sen. Bato dela Rosa mula sa International Criminal Court (ICC) sa Senado kamakailan.

Ayon kay Trillanes, sinunod lang naman daw niya ang request ni dela Rosa kaya siya nagtungo sa Senado. | via Maeanne Los Baños

text:
As of 2:00 AM today, 11 May 2026, Tropical Depression "CALOY" {Int'l name "HAGUPIT"} is being monitored inside the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).

Meanwhile, a Low Pressure Area (LPA 05c) is being monitored outside the PAR and is "UNLIKELY" to develop into a tropical depression within the next 24 hours.

All are advised to monitor updates from DOST-PAGASA.

TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 5
Tropical Depression #CaloyPH (HAGUPIT)
Issued at 11:00 PM, 10 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next bulletin at 5:00 AM tomorrow.

“CALOY” MAINTAINS ITS STRENGTH AS IT MOVES WEST NORTHWESTWARD OVER THE PHILIPPINE SEA.

• Location of Center (10:00 PM):
The center of Tropical Depression CALOY was estimated based on all available data at 610 km East of Surigao City, Surigao del Norte (10.4°N, 131.0°E).

• Intensity:
Maximum sustained winds of 45 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 55 km/h, and central pressure of 1004 hPa

• Present Movement:
West northwestward at 15 km/h

• Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds:
Strong winds extend outwards up to 320 km from the center

TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNALS (TCWS) IN EFFECT

➣ No Wind Signal is currently hoisted

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS

➣ CALOY is unlikely to directly affect the country throughout the forecast period.

HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS

➣ 24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.0 m: The seaboards of Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela, Ilocos Norte, northern Ilocos Sur, Aurora, Camarines Norte, Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, and Surigao del Sur; the western seaboard of Pangasinan; the northern seaboards of Camarines Sur; the northern and eastern seaboards of Quezon including Polillo Islands, and Catanduanes; the eastern seaboards of Albay, Sorsogon, Eastern Samar, Dinagat Islands, Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands, and Davao Oriental.
• Mariners of motorbancas and similarly sized vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK

• CALOY will continue moving west northwestward in the next 12 hours and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. 
• This weather disturbance is forecast to further weaken into a remnant low tomorrow (11 May).

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

The next tropical cyclone bulletin will be issued at 5:00 AM tomorrow.
 
 
DOST-PAGASA

text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 4
Tropical Depression #CaloyPH (HAGUPIT)
Issued at 5:00 PM, 10 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next bulletin at 11:00 PM today.

“CALOY” CONTINUES TO WEAKEN OVER THE PHILIPPINE SEA EAST OF CARAGA.

• Location of Center (4:00 PM)
The center of Tropical Depression CALOY was estimated based on all available data at 680 km East of Surigao City, Surigao del Norte (10.1°N, 131.7°E).

• Intensity
Maximum sustained winds of 45 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 55 km/h, and central pressure of 1004 hPa

• Present Movement
Westward at 15 km/h

• Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds
Strong winds extend outwards up to 320 km from the center

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS

➣ CALOY is unlikely to directly affect the country throughout the forecast period.

HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS

➣ 24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.5 m: The eastern seaboards of Northern Samar and Eastern Samar.
• Up to 2.0 m: The seaboards of Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela, Ilocos Norte, northern Ilocos Sur, Aurora, Camarines Norte, and Surigao del Sur; the western seaboard of Pangasinan; the northern seaboards of Camarines Sur and Northern Samar; the northern and eastern seaboards of Quezon including Polillo Islands, and Catanduanes; the eastern seaboards of Albay, Sorsogon, Eastern Samar, Dinagat Islands, Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands, and Davao Oriental.
• Mariners of motorbancas and similarly vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK

• CALOY will continue moving west northwestward in the next 12 hours and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. 
• This weather disturbance is forecast to further weaken into a remnant low tomorrow (11 May).

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

The next tropical cyclone bulletin will be issued at 11:00 PM today.
 
DOST-PAGASA 

Link: tinyurl.com/CaloyPH
