text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 3
Tropical Depression #CaloyPH (HAGUPIT)
Issued at 11:00 AM, 10 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next bulletin at 5:00 PM today.

CALOY HAS WEAKENED INTO A TROPICAL DEPRESSION WHILE MOVING OVER THE SEA EAST OF NORTHEASTERN MINDANAO.

• Location of Center (10:00 AM):
The center of Tropical Depression CALOY was estimated based on all available data at 770 km East of Surigao City, Surigao del Norte (10.1°N, 132.5°E).

• Intensity:
Maximum sustained winds of 55 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 70 km/h, and central pressure of 1004 hPa

• Present Movement:
Northwestward at 10 km/h

• Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds:
Strong to gale-force winds extend outwards up to 320 km from the center

TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNALS (TCWS) IN EFFECT
➣ No Wind Signal is currently hoisted

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS

➣ CALOY is unlikely to directly affect the country throughout the forecast period.

HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS

➣ 24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.5 m: The eastern seaboards of Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, and Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands; the seaboards of Batanes.
• Up to 2.0 m: The remaining seaboards of Ilocos Norte and Babuyan Islands; the eastern seaboards of Cagayan, Isabela, Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, Albay, Sorsogon, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Sur, and Davao Oriental; the northern seaboards of Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, and Northern Samar; the western seaboard of Babuyan Islands; the northwestern seaboard of Ilocos Norte.
• Mariners of motorbancas and similarly vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK

• CALOY will continue moving west northwestward throughout the forecast period and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. 
• This weather disturbance is forecast to further weaken into a remnant low tomorrow (11 May).

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

The next tropical cyclone bulletin will be issued at 5:00 PM today.
 
DOST-PAGASA 
Link: https://tinyurl.com/CaloyPH

text:
Contrary to claims made by Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano and other members of the new majority bloc, the Senate was not under attack, Malacañang maintained on Monday.

“Was it under attack? It was not. The Senate was not under attack. You can see that from the news, not only from the statements of the NBI (National Bureau of Investigation) and PNP (Philippine National Police),” Presidential Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro pointed out during a press briefing. https://tinyurl.com/y23886zk | via ONE News

text:
Dalawang kongresista, nagbitiw bilang miyembro ng Kamara ngayong 20th Congress

Sa sesyon ngayong Lunes, inanunsyo na nagsumite ng resignation letters sina 1-Tahanan PL Rep.e Nathaniel Oducado at Pinoy Workers PL Rep. Franz Legazpi.

Wala namang binanggit na rason ng kanilang pagbibitiw.

Inatasan ang House Secretary General na tanggalin ang dalawa mula sa roll of members ng Kamara.

Inaasahan namang magkakaroon ng bagong kinatawan ang dalawang party-list sa Kapulungan.

text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 2
Tropical Storm #CaloyPH (HAGUPIT)
Issued at 5:00 AM, 10 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next bulletin at 11:00 AM today.

TROPICAL STORM CALOY SLIGHTLY DECELERATES 
WHILE MOVING OVER THE SEA EAST OF NORTHEASTERN MINDANAO.

• Location of Center (4:00 AM)
The center of Tropical Storm CALOY was estimated based on all available data at 910 km East of Northeastern Mindanao (9.9°N, 133.8°E).
• Intensity
Maximum sustained winds of 65 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 80 km/h, and central pressure of 1002 hPa
• Present Movement
West northwestward at 15 km/h
• Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds
Strong to gale-force winds extend outwards up to 320 km from the center

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS
CALOY is unlikely to directly affect the country throughout the forecast period.
HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS

24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.5 m: The eastern seaboards of Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, and Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands; the seaboards of Batanes; the western seaboard of Babuyan Islands; the northwestern seaboard of Ilocos Norte.
• Up to 2.0 m: The remaining seaboards of Ilocos Norte and Babuyan Islands; the eastern seaboards of Cagayan, Isabela, Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, Albay, Sorsogon, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Sur, and Davao Oriental; the northern seaboards of Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, and Northern Samar.
• Mariners of montorbancas and similarly vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK
• Tropical Storm CALOY will continue moving west northwestward throughout the forecast period and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. 
• Weakening trend will likely begin this afternoon or evening. It is forecast to be downgraded into a tropical depression between this afternoon and evening and further weakening into a remnant low tomorrow (11 May).

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

The next tropical cyclone bulletin will be issued at 11:00 AM today.
 
DOST-PAGASA

Link: https://tinyurl.com/CaloyPH

𝐁𝐢𝐧𝐢 𝐬𝐚 𝐊𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐚! 

Binigyang-pagkilala ng Kamara ang P-Pop sensation na BINI.

Ngayong Lunes, May 18, 2026, dumayo ang BINI sa Batasan Pambansa para personal na tanggapin ang pinagtibay na resolusyon.

Dito nakasaad na kinikilala ng Kamara ang BINI dahil sa makasaysayan nilang performance sa Coachella 2026 sa California sa Amerika, na isang “major breakthrough” para sa Original Pilipino Music o OPM at talentong Pinoy sa pandaidigang entablado.

text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 1
Tropical Storm #CaloyPH (HAGUPIT)
Issued at 11:00 PM, 09 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next bulletin at 5:00 AM tomorrow.

TROPICAL STORM CALOY MAINTAINS ITS STRENGTH WHILE MOVING OVER THE PHILIPPINE SEA.

• Location of Center (10:00 PM)
The center of Tropical Storm CALOY was estimated based on all available data at 870 km East of Northeastern Mindanao (9.3°N, 134.2°E).
• Intensity
Maximum sustained winds of 65 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 80 km/h, and central pressure of 1002 hPa
• Present Movement
West northwestward at 20 km/h
• Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds
Strong to gale-force winds extend outwards up to 320 km from the center

TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNALS (TCWS) IN EFFECT
No Wind Signal is currently hoisted

OTHER HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS
CALOY is unlikely to directly affect the country throughout the forecast period.
HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS

24-Hour Sea Condition Outlook

Up to moderate seas over the following coastal waters:
• Up to 2.5 m: The eastern seaboards of Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, and Siargao-Bucas Grande Islands; the seaboards of Batanes; the western seaboard of Babuyan Islands; the northwestern seaboard of Ilocos Norte.
• Up to 2.0 m: The remaining seaboards of Ilocos Norte and Babuyan Islands; the eastern seaboards of Cagayan, Isabela, Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, Albay, Sorsogon, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Sur, and Davao Oriental; the northern seaboards of Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, and Northern Samar.
• Mariners of montorbancas and similarly vessels are advised to take precautionary measures while venturing out to sea and, if possible, avoid navigation under these conditions.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK
• Tropical Storm CALOY will continue moving west northwestward throughout the forecast period and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. 
• In the next 12 hours, CALOY may maintain its strength. Weakening trend will likely begin tomorrow (10 May) evening. It is forecast to weaken into a tropical depression by tomorrow evening and further weakening into a remnant low on Monday (11 May).

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to take all necessary measures to protect life and property. Persons living in areas identified to be highly or very highly susceptible to these hazards are advised to follow evacuation and other instructions from local officials. For heavy rainfall warnings, thunderstorm/rainfall advisories, and other severe weather information specific to your area, please monitor products issued by your local PAGASA Regional Services Division.

The next tropical cyclone bulletin will be issued at 5:00 AM tomorrow.

DOST-PAGASA

As of 8:00 PM today, 09 May 2026, Tropical Storm "HAGUPIT" (formerly LPA 05b) is being monitored inside the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).

Meanwhile, a Low Pressure Area (LPA 05c) is being monitored inside the monitoring domain of PAGASA (TCID) and is "UNLIKELY" to develop into a tropical depression within the next 24 hours.

All are advised to monitor updates from DOST-PAGASA.

Daily prayer (via plough)

And by him we cry, “Abba, Father.” The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children. Now if we are children, then we are heirs – heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if indeed we share in his sufferings in order that we may also share in his glory. Romans 8:15b–17, NIV

Lord our God, Father of us all, grant that we may know something of you in our hearts. Each one of us is different, with his own particular needs, but we are all your children and should all become children of your Spirit. Then even in the difficulties of life, in the many struggles, temptations, and sorrows, we can keep up our courage and remain in the Spirit, who is victorious in every aspect of life. Protect and strengthen us on all our ways. We praise you for all you have done and for all the help you have given us. Amen.
The Philippine peso tumbled to a fresh all-time low on Monday, May 18, 2026, closing at 61.75 against the US dollar.

Ayon kay Palace Press Officer Usec. Claire Castro, si Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano lamang ang nagsasabing naging "under attack" ang Senado.

“The Senate was not under attack. You can see that from the news. Not only from the statements of the NBI and PNP. It was only the statement made by Senator Alan Cayetano,” saad niya sa press briefing nitong Lunes.

text:
PCSO Turns Over Rescue, Health Equipment to Puerto Galera under CSR Program

As part of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Program, PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles turned over various rescue and health-related equipment to the local government unit of Puerto Galera on May 13, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office in Mandaluyong City.

The items were received by Puerto Galera Vice Mayor Rocky Ilagan during the turnover ceremony.

Among the equipment turned over were 20 trauma bags, 20 oxygen tanks, 20 handheld radios, 20 rescue helmets with headlamps, 20 rescue ropes, 25 stretchers, 20 life jackets, and 10 weighing scales.

Vice Mayor Ilagan expressed his appreciation to PCSO, noting that the rescue and health-related equipment will greatly benefit not only the residents of Puerto Galera but also the tourists visiting the municipality.

Through this initiative, PCSO continues to deliver compassionate service and implement programs that promote the safety, health, and welfare of more Filipinos.    

“PCSO, Hindi Umuurong sa Pagtulong!’’

In Partnership with Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office

text:
PCSO Provides Healthcare Devices, Mobility Aids to Vulnerable Sectors in  

The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over healthcare devices, mobility aids, and hygiene kits to the local government unit of Victoria, Oriental Mindoro, as part of its continuing Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Program.

PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles led the turnover ceremony held on May 13, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office in Mandaluyong City. The donation was received by Victoria Mayor Richard Inciong on behalf of the municipality.

The assistance is intended to support senior citizens, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable residents of Victoria who need basic healthcare and mobility support.

The items turned over included 150 hygiene kits, 20 blood pressure apparatus, 20 nebulizers, 20 glucometers, 20 thermal scanners, 20 pulse oximeters, 20 weighing scales, five walkers, four wheelchairs, and three canes.

Mayor Inciong expressed his appreciation to PCSO, noting that the donated items would help the municipal government provide better assistance to residents in need, particularly those requiring regular health monitoring and mobility support.

Through its CSR Program, PCSO continues to extend assistance to communities across the country by providing programs and services that promote the health, safety, and well-being of more Filipinos.

‘’PCSO, Hindi Umuurong sa Pagtulong!’’

In Partnership with Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office

text:
TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY NR. 6
Tropical Storm HAGUPIT
Issued at 11:00 AM, 09 May 2026
Valid for broadcast until the next advisory at 11:00 PM today.

“HAGUPIT” SLIGHTLY WEAKENS AS IT MOVES WESTWARD OVER THE NORTHEAST OF PALAU.

Location of Center (10:00 AM):
The center of Tropical Storm HAGUPIT was estimated based on all available data at 1,065 km East of Northeastern Mindanao (OUTSIDE PAR) (8.8°N, 136.0°E). 

Intensity: 
Maximum sustained winds of 65 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 80 km/h, and central pressure of 1002 hPa 
Present Movement: 
Westward at 20 km/h 

Extent of Tropical Cyclone Winds:
Strong to gale-force winds extend outwards up to 320 km from the center 

GENERAL OUTLOOK FOR THE FORECAST PERIOD
• HAGUPIT is forecast to move west northwestward during the majority of the forecast period and will remain over the Philippine Sea, far from the Philippine landmass. It will enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) today and will be given the local name CALOY. 
• In the next 12 hours, HAGUPIT may maintain its strength as it continues to move over the Philippine Sea until it enters PAR. However, it may begin weakening starting tomorrow (10 May) due to unfavorable environment. HAGUPIT will become a tropical depression tomorrow and will further weaken into a low-pressure area on Monday (11 May).
• HAGUPIT is less likely to directly affect the weather and sea conditions in the next 48 hours.

Considering these developments, the public and disaster risk reduction and management offices concerned are advised to continue monitoring for updates related to this tropical cyclone. 

Unless there is an intermediate issuance, the next tropical cyclone advisory will be issued at 11:00 PM today.
 

DOST-PAGASA

text:
Hydrological Forecast for Cagayan River Basin   
Issued at 8:30AM, 09 May 2026

'EVENTS IN THE LAST FEW MONTHS WAS ALSO INTENTIONAL'

Sinabi ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano na ang mga kasalukuyang pangyayari sa Senado ay bahagi ng mas malawak na hakbang para sa constitutional change na posibleng magpahina sa institusyon.

Sa press briefing nitong Lunes, iginiit niyang isa itong hakbang na nagsimula pa noong 2023 upang ipakilala ang "Regional Senate."

"'Yung attack on the Senate started naman in 2023, nu'ng gusto nilang i-abolish ang Senate. And I really believe that the events in the last few months was also intentional na ma-weaken ang Senate because bubuhayin 'yung Constitutional change except this time around, regional Senate ang gusto nila," aniya.

Dagdag pa niya, bagamat maganda sa konsepto ang pagkakaroon ng regional representation, maaari umano itong magdulot ng pagiging "rubber stamp" kung mas dadami ang miyembro ng Senado.

Nilinaw nina Senador Migz Zubiri at JV Ejercito ang kanilang posisyon sa Senado sa pamamagitan ng pagsali sa minority bloc nitong Lunes.

Nag-convene na rin bilang impeachment court ang Senado para sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte.

PANOORIN:
Sen. Robin Padilla did not directly answer questions on Monday, May 18, 2026, about his alleged involvement in Sen. Bato Dela Rosa's evasion from arrest.

text: #FrontlinePilipinas | Walang nangyaring kudeta kaya nananatiling Senate President si Alan Peter Cayetano. | via Maeanne Los Baños-Oroceo

A further exploration beyond Barcelona reveals an underappreciated wealth of culinary, craft, coastal, and cultural traditions that would sate any traveler’s appetite (via Lifestyle.INQ) 

Read more: https://lifestyle.inquirer.net/571633/beyond-barcelona-get-off-the-beaten-track-in-catalonia/
Katseye to hold ‘WildWorld Tour’ across 3 continents, unveils dates
Rabiya Mateo, Jake Cuenca enjoy Disneyland before actress enters med school
Filipinos can now visit Angola visa-free for 30 days
Ombudsman seeks list of media personnel present during Senate shooting
P1.49-million illegal drugs, gun seized in Iloilo City
The Senate’s committee lineup took clearer shape on Monday, May 18, 2026, after the shakeup that shifted alliances into a new majority that installed Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano.

The Department of Justice has recommended the filing of plunder and graft charges against Sen. Jinggoy Estrada and several former public works officials over an alleged scheme involving hundreds of millions of pesos in public funds.
The Senate formally convened as an impeachment court on Monday, May 18, 2026, marking the official start of the trial of cases against Vice President Sara Duterte.

''YUNG ATTACK ON THE SENATE STARTED NAMAN IN 2023'

Iginiit ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano na may mga pagkilos na umano mula pa noong 2023 na naglalayong buwagin ang Senado at palitan ito ng "Regional Senate."

Sa isang press briefing nitong Lunes, sinabi niya na ang mga nagdaang kaganapan ay maaaring bahagi ng mas malawak na pagtatangkang pahinain ang institusyon kaugnay ng isinusulong na constitutional change.

"'Yung attack on the Senate started naman in 2023, nu'ng gusto nilang i-abolish ang Senate. And I really believe that the events in the last few months was also intentional na ma-weaken ang Senate because bubuhayin 'yung Constitutional change except this time around, regional Senate ang gusto nila," aniya.

Dagdag pa niya, bagamat maganda sa konsepto ang pagkakaroon ng regional representation, maaari umano itong magdulot ng pagiging "rubber stamp" kung mas dadami ang miyembro ng Senado.

text:
𝐇𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐢 𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐒𝐞𝐧𝐚𝐝𝐨 

Malakanyang, kinontra ang pahayag ni Senate President Cayetano  na inatake ang Senado noong May 13, 2026.

The P-pop scene welcomed a fresh new act as XONARA made their much-anticipated debut with “Tabi” at their official launch on May 16, 2026 in Escolta, Manila.

The seven-member group — Eurekah, Ella, Dominique, Tin, Megumi, Lei, and Namie — was formed under 1Z Entertainment, the agency co-founded by P-pop icons SB19.

WATCH:

Isang linggo matapos mag-abstain sa pagboto sa pagbabago ng liderato sa Senado, ipinahayag nina Senador Migz Zubiri at JV Ejercito na sasama sila sa minority bloc ng Senado.

Bunsod nito, kasalukuyang 11 na ang bilang ng minorya.

PANOORIN:
Long lines, police intervention, and shopper brawls—Swatch was forced to shut stores after overwhelming demand for its Royal Pop collab with Audemars Piguet. | via PhilSTAR Life

text:
SEN. BATO CAMP ANSWERS OSG REPLY ON SC PETITION VS. ICC WARRANT

Naghain na ng tugon ang kampo ni Sen. Bato dela Rosa sa komento ng Office of the Solicitor General (OSG) sa hiling ng senador sa Korte Suprema na ipatigil ang pagpapatupad ng kaniyang International Criminal Court (ICC) arrest warrant.

"We maintain that an international process, standing alone, cannot automatically operate as a Philippine warrant of arrest," pahayag ng legal counsel na si Atty. Israelito Torreon.

"[N]o Filipino may be arrested, surrendered, transferred, rendered, or removed from Philippine territory unless there is clear domestic legal authority and full compliance with the safeguards guaranteed by the Bill of Rights."

text:
LEAD PROSECUTOR SA VP SARA TRIAL

Pormal nang naghain ng Entry of Appearance ang 11-member House prosecution panel sa Senate impeachment court hapon ngayong Lunes, May 18.

Sa naturang dokumento, pinangalanan si House Committee on Justice Chair and 2nd District Batangas Rep. Jinky Luistro bilang lead public prosecutor.

Kasama rin sa prosecution panel sina Reps. Terry Ridon, Rodge Gutierrez, Ysabel Zamora, Lorenz Defensor, Chel Diokno, Leila de Lima, Arlene Bag-ao, Jonathan Keith Flores, Lordan Suan, at Joel Chua. | via Marianne Enriquez

text:
The 11-member House Prosecution panel formally filed its Entry of Appearance before the Senate Impeachment Court Monday afternoon, signaling the House’s readiness to proceed with the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

Batangas 2nd District Rep. Gerville Luistro was named lead public prosecutor in the formal pleading submitted before the Senate after senators took their oath as impeachment judges.

The prosecution panel includes Reps. Terry Ridon, Rodge Gutierrez, Ysabel Zamora, Lorenz Defensor, Chel Diokno, Leila de Lima, Arlene Bag-ao, Jonathan Keith Flores, Lordan Suan, and Joel Chua. | via Marianne Enriquez/News5

text:
‘BAKIT? GUSTO BA NAMING TIBAGIN ‘YUNG SENADO?’

Ito ang tugon ni National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag kasunod ng mensahe ni Senate Pres. Alan Peter Cayetano sa ahensya na hindi umano nila natibag ang Senado sa ilalim ng kaniyang leadership.

Depensa ng NBI chief, wala silang balak na gawin ang naturang bagay.

“Gusto lang naming ipatupad ‘yung batas. Saka, it's not about Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano, it's about the Senate and the judicial system,” paliwanag ni Matibag. I via Dave Abuel

Sagot 'yan ni Senate President Peter Alan Cayetano kung humingi ba ng clearance si Acting senate SGT-at-Arms Ret. Gen. Mao Aplasca sa pagwa-warning shot noong Miyerkules, May 13, 2026. 

🎥Nimfa Ravelo, DZBB

text:
‘HINDI TOTOO’

Pinabulaanan ni Sen. Robin Padilla ang kumakalat na ulat na isinakay niya umano si Sen. Bato dela Rosa sa isang yate.

Wala rin umanong katotohanan na namataan siya, kasama ni dela Rosa, sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) umaga noong Huwebes, May 14.

Gayunman, tumanggi siyang kumpirmahin o pabulaanan kung siya ang naglabas kay dela Rosa sa Senado.

Wala rin daw siyang magagawa kung itinuturing siyang person of interest kaugnay sa usapin.

Aniya, hintayin na lamang ang isasagawang imbestigasyon sa usapin ng pag-alis ni dela Rosa sa ilalim ng protective custody ng Senado. I via #MOJO Marymon Reyes

text:
LUISTRO, LEAD PROSECUTOR SA VP SARA TRIAL

Pormal nang inihain ng House prosecution panel ang kanilang entry of appearance sa Senate impeachment court ngayong Lunes, May 18 para sa nakatakdang paglilitis kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte.

Sa tatlong pahinang dokumento, pinangalanan si House Committee on Justice Chair and 2nd District Batangas Rep. Jinky Luistro bilang lead public prosecutor. | via Marianne Enriquez

text:
SEN. RODANTE MARCOLETA O SEN. PIA CAYETANO?

Tinutukoy na ni Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano kung sino ang posibleng maupo bilang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee chairperson matapos mabakante ang puwesto kasunod ng kamakailang pagbabago sa liderato ng Senado.

Ayon kay Cayetano, kabilang sa mga kinokonsidera para sa chairmanship sina Sen. Rodante Marcoleta at Sen. Pia Cayetano.

text:
'𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐮𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐤𝐨, 𝐍𝐚𝐠𝐮𝐥𝐚𝐭 𝐚𝐤𝐨 𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐚 𝐬𝐚 𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐬𝐲𝐨𝐧 𝐧𝐚 𝐢𝐭𝐨'

Pahayag 'yan ni Sen. Migz Zubiri matapos niyang ihanay ang sarili bilang kasapi ng Senate minority.

"With the handling of shootout, natauhan ako, Nagulat ako para sa institusyon na ito, at napaisip ako ng malalim. 

Tinanong nga ako ng mga anak ko kung bakit nagkaganito sa Senado. So I prayed hard and sought for discernment, and I said it’s about time to make a stand na maiba ang pangyayari dito sa Senado, na maibalik natin ang dignidad ng Senado. 

For the first time in the history, nagkaputukan dito,  at nagkagulo-gulo. That has never happened in the history of this great body. So we made the decision, I made the decision with my family that it has to change."

text:
NAG-RESIGN NA MGA KONGRESISTA

Inanunsyo sa plenary session ng Kamara ngayong Lunes, May 18 ang pagbibitiiw nina 1Tahanan Rep. Nathaniel Oducado at Pinoy Workers Rep. Franz Legazpi bilang House members.

Walang binanggit na rason sa resignation ng dalawang party-list representatives.

Inatsan ang House secretary-general na tanggalin sila sa roll of members ng Kamara.

Umabot na sa apat ang nag-resign na kongresista sa 20th Congress. Nauna nang nagbitiw sina Zaldy Co ng Ako Bicol Party-list, at Edvic Yap ng ACT-CIS Party-list.

WATCH: Lava flows from Mayon Volcano on Monday, May 18, at 9:46 p.m, as seen in this sped-up video from Phivolcs.

Hot ash and pyroclastic density currents or “uson” travelled down the Mi-isi gully and reached about 2 km from the crater, according to Phivolcs.

Mayon’s eruption has now entered its 133rd straight day. Alert Level 3 remains in effect, and entry into the 6-km danger zone is strictly prohibited. | 🎥: Phivolcs via April Benjamin, INQUIRER.net

NEWEST GIRL GROUP IN TOWN

Rising P-pop girl group XONARA officially stepped into the spotlight with the release of their debut single “Tabi” during their launch event held on May 16, 2026 in Escolta, Manila.

Formed under 1Z Entertainment, the agency co-founded by P-pop powerhouse SB19, XONARA is composed of members Eurekah, Ella, Dominique, Tin, Megumi, Lei, and Namie.

'I GUESS WE JUST HAVE TO WAIT AND SEE'

Nagbahagi si Pres. Bongbong Marcos ng kanyang reaksyon sa mga nangyari sa Senado.

Kasabay ito ng kanyang pagdalo sa isang event ng pamahalaan sa Mandaluyong ngayong Lunes, May 18.

text:
13 MAJORITY VS. 11 MINORITY

Nadagdagan ang miyembro ng minorya ng Senado ngayong Lunes, May 18 matapos sumama sina Sen. Migz Zubiri at Sen. JV Ejercito.

Hindi naman natuloy ang umuugong na ulat na magkakaron muli ng papapalit ng liderato sa Senado.
